scope: Source-matched native wavelength-offset probe and controlled profile-coordinate comparisons on fixed external CN populations/constants. Preserve original AIR grid; convert to vacuum once through canonical owner. Separate linearization, coordinate conversion and width/a/stim rescaling. Extinction profiles and finite AIR-window integrals are not emergent flux, EWs, independent chemistry validation or abundance corrections. No background provider or NLTE run in this phase.
